definitions.full: H3451. yeshimah [ יְשִׁימָה ] noun feminine desolation , only intensive plural יְשִׁימוֺת Psa 55:16 Kt (Qr מָוֶת יַשִּׁיא ), so Ges Hup and others, compare proper name, of a location הישׁימות בית above; ᵐ5 Ew Ol Pe De Bae and others follow Qr, let death come deceitfully upon them , see נשׁא .
